'''Ben's Mesa''', also known as the '''Benzin Plateau''', was a flat-topped [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] in the center of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] racetrack on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was named for [[Ben Neluenf/Legends|Ben Neluenf]], the first great Tatooine-born racer who lost his life in a spectacular attempt to scale the central mesa. Most of Boonta Eve's canyons cut through Ben's Mesa, including famous [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] chose "Ben" as an alias after overhearing the mesa's name while en route to Tatooine with the infant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref> (By coincidence, he had also used the name as an alias during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].)<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ben's Mesa appeared as a designated planetary region in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the mesa was identified as the "Benzin Plateau," situated in the center of the racetrack.<ref name="AED" />
